title: The Early Black Friday Bargains Worth Bagging
gist: WIRED's Thanksgiving Day 2026 Black Friday deals roundup of reviewer-tested gadgets, noting deal season now starts before November; headline cuts include Pixel 11 Pro/XL (~31-32% off), AirPods Pro 3 at a record $149, Galaxy Z Fold8 at $1,550 and LG's 65-inch C6 OLED at half price. Largely promotional, with light signal on discount depth and subscription-free hardware appeal.

insights.claim: Black Friday discounting has spread well beyond the day itself, first to Cyber Monday and Cyber Week and now to early deals starting before November, making it harder for shoppers to tell genuine deals from prices that will fall further.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Extended promo windows spread holiday consumer-electronics demand and pressure retailer margins over a longer period.
insights.quote: Now, early Black Friday deals kick off before November has even started.

insights.claim: Over Thanksgiving 2026, Google's Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL were discounted 32% and 31% on Amazon ($1,099 to $750; $1,299 to $899), deeper than the 22% cut on the base Pixel 11.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Deep cuts on premium Pixels suggest aggressive Google push for Android flagship share into the holidays.
insights.locator: GooglePixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL

insights.claim: Apple's AirPods Pro 3 hit a record-low $149 (40% off $249) and Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold8 fell $350 to a record-low $1,550 during the 2026 Thanksgiving deals.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Record-low pricing on flagship wearables and foldables signals heavy promotional intensity in premium consumer electronics.

insights.claim: LG's 65-inch C6 OLED TV was discounted 50% to $1,350 from $2,700 on Amazon over Thanksgiving 2026.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Half-price OLED flagships point to TV panel price pressure and promotional competition in premium TVs.

insights.claim: WIRED's reviewers warn that most Black Friday TV deals are on poor-quality models that should not be bought, and advise pairing smart TVs with a separate streaming device and disabling tracking.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Doorbuster TV volume skews to low-end SKUs; TV-platform data/ad monetization faces consumer pushback on tracking.
insights.quote: The reality is that most Black Friday TV deals are on terrible models you should never buy.
insights.locator: I always associate Black Friday with footage

themes.theme: Subscription-free and repairable as selling points

insights.claim: WIRED's deal picks repeatedly highlight subscription-free smart home gear (EufyCam S4, Eufy Video Doorbell E340, Everblog HomeCal) and the repairable Fairphone (Gen 6+), now available in the US, as differentiators.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Consumer fatigue with subscriptions favors hardware makers offering local storage/AI over recurring-fee models like cloud camera plans.
insights.quote: The Everblog HomeCal is our pick for folks who can’t stomach another subscription.
